objective: Image-driven multi-view surface reconstruction: VGGT-Omega supplies coarse cameras, scale, silhouette and initial geometry only; differentiable rendering of the original RGB optimises the surface, with material/lighting factored for glossy scenes. VGGT depth is initialisation, not a supervision target.

revision.summary: Main line changed from VGGT depth/normal correction to image-driven surface reconstruction on a VGGT-initialised coarse geometry.
revision.history_status: phase1 retained; phases P2-P6 and the phase3 ladder marked superseded

hardware.training_policy: no VGGT-Omega training or fine-tuning under any circumstance
hardware.resource_policy: long runs in tmux with logs on disk; do not kill other users' jobs; prefer microbatch/resolution reduction before deep tuning

non_goals: VGGT depth/normal as a supervision target
URGT / HyDen priors (main line or appendix)
strong VGGT depth loss inside Stage 2

gates.vggt_inference_valid: checkpoint sha256 matches; 16-view export contract complete

phases.name: cross-scene baselines and unified evaluation
phases.note: ETH3D is internal geometry evaluation until the official visibility protocol is implemented.

phases.name: ExMesh E0-E3 ablation
phases.arms: E0-E3; separate initialization quality from optimization supervision; Lego first, then relief

phases.name: Mesh Splatting
phases.pipeline: DMTet -> softening -> remeshing -> export; one scene first; stop-loss to ExMesh split/merge on overrun

env.name: 3dtex
env.pytorch3d: source build 0.7.9; quaternion_to_matrix CUDA forward verified
env.exmesh_extensions: simple-knn and diff-plane-rasterization built; build_rotation quaternion forward verified

phase1.primary_metric: F-score at 1 voxel, observed GT depth points, frozen 0.01150144350298549 m grid

peak_sampling.method: external nvidia-smi memory.used polling every 30 ms; peak minus idle; per-process query unsupported in container

scenes.gt: rendered observed GT depth from the same 16 views
scenes.label: internal_p0

phase2_protocol.heldout_policy: heldout images never enter VGGT, TSDF, mesh optimisation or geometry metrics; reserved for phase 6 appearance
phase2_protocol.gt_isolation: GT cameras, scan, rendered depth and foreground masks are read only by evaluation; reconstruction inputs limited to dataset images and VGGT outputs

arms.B0: raw VGGT depth/confidence -> train-only Sim(3) -> TSDF uniform weights, nearest sampling, no filter, no carving (no GT)
arms.B1: consistency_filter (no masks, tau_abs=1% camera span, tau_rel=0.05, min_agree=2, no confidence cut) -> confidence-weighted TSDF, nearest (no GT)
arms.B1_legacy: Lego v35c30 free-space carving with GT foreground masks + confidence fusion; diagnostic only, GT-assisted, excluded from cross-scene gates

lego.rule: assert frozen values for B0/B1/B1_legacy; never recompute

eth3d.reuse_rule: B1 and all phase-3 G arms pass --roi-geometry <B0 omega>; voxel/shape mismatch invalidates the run
eth3d.forbidden: no GT-derived grid (no GT camera bbox, no scan bbox)

metrics.evaluator: scripts/eval_point_metrics.py (implemented and synthetically self-tested 2026-11-04: offset 0.01 -> chamfer 0.010715; Sim(3) scale 1.3 recovered as 1.3000000000000005)
metrics.alignment: train-only Sim(3) from predicted camera centres to GT camera centres; scale applied to depth and mesh; no per-view scale/shift
metrics.sampling: 50k fixed-seed area-weighted mesh samples; 50k fixed-seed GT samples
metrics.accuracy: mean nearest distance mesh samples -> GT point set
metrics.completeness: mean nearest distance GT samples -> mesh samples
metrics.chamfer: symmetric mean of accuracy and completeness
metrics.fscore: F1 at 1 P0 voxel and F2 at 2 voxels
metrics.threshold_units: Lego uses the P0 voxel directly (GT gauge); ETH3D uses P0 voxel x Sim(3) scale and records scale in surface_metrics.json
metrics.lego_secondary: Blender measure_surfaces triangle-exact metrics and normal error for phase-1 continuity
metrics.output: outputs/72h/<scene>_<arm>/surface_metrics.json with grid and GT sample hashes

run_validity: VGGT manifest frames and checkpoint sha256 match, no NaN depth
mesh exists with >1000 vertices and >0 triangles, no NaN/Inf
voxel and shape match the frozen grid
single scene arm <=30 min and nvidia-smi peak delta <=10 GB
batch, peak VRAM, sps, gate verdict and log path recorded
gates.b1_improves_scene: chamfer relative decrease >=2% AND f1 absolute increase >=0.005
gates.b1_cross_scene: improvement on >=2/3 ETH3D scenes AND on Lego
gates.degradation_guard: any scene with chamfer degradation >5% or f1 drop >0.02 fails the overall gate
gates.lego_absolute_floor: B1 chamfer <=0.0135 and F1 >=0.62 (not relaxed when GT masks are removed; failure recorded as a negative result)
gates.eth3d_absolute: no pre-declared absolute floor; first B0 values are descriptive baseline under the same protocol

eth3d.notes: completeness uses the full scan without official visibility masking, so numbers are conservative and never compared with the official leaderboard

plan_2026_11_05.goal: Recover accurate surfaces from multi-view RGB by differentiable rendering, starting from VGGT-Omega coarse geometry; VGGT is initialisation, not supervision.
removed_from_all_plans: VGGT depth/normal as a supervision target

stage1_surface_recovery.loss: lambda_s silhouette + lambda_c correspondence + lambda_r render + lambda_g geometry
stage1_surface_recovery.topology: allowed; wrong triangles may be removed and rebuilt

stage2_explicit_refinement.forbidden: strong VGGT depth loss (would pull the corrected geometry back)

stages.appearance: Factored-NeuS-style material/lighting decomposition for glossy objects; otherwise the RGB loss explains geometry error away

step0_objective_validity.0a_appearance_fit: fix GT Mesh and VGGT Mesh separately, optimise constrained appearance only on 16 train views, evaluate on 4 heldout; the GT mesh must render clearly better on heldout
step0_objective_validity.0b_known_perturbation: perturb the GT mesh by +/-0.5/1/2 voxel along normals, smoothing and hole filling, then optimise geometry; gradient direction agreement >=80% with monotone error decrease
step0_objective_validity.0c_gloss_diagnostic: if highlight regions give reversed gradients the appearance model fails; material/lighting decomposition is then mandatory
step0_objective_validity.gate: A/B/C do not start until 0a and 0b pass; thresholds are frozen after Step 0

0a.rule: GT-mesh held-out PSNR exceeds VGGT-mesh by >= 1 dB

0b.rule: vertex gradient direction restores the perturbation toward the reference in >= 80% of cases

0c.note: no systematic reversal, but close to chance

step0_1_diagnostics.note: New separate test; the Step 0 80% NO-GO result and numbers are preserved unchanged

code_fixes.local_deformation: V_i(a) = V_i^0 + a*w_i*n_i with a sigma=4 voxel Gaussian bump; per-vertex direction ratio retired
code_fixes.finite_difference: central difference h=0.2 voxel against autograd for scalar a
code_fixes.curvature_mask: normalised by the actual number of incident faces instead of dividing by 3
code_fixes.photometric_loss: optional symmetric silhouette term |alpha - GT mask| over the full image; Step 0 foreground-only loss is not comparable

level2_supervision_effectiveness.note: silhouette-only is a coverage-bound diagnostic, not a veto

gate_result.baseline_choice: nvdiffrec (DMTet/FlexiCubes + nvdiffrast); reuses the existing renderer and adds the surface parameterisation/regularisation Step 0.1 identified as missing

level3_real_reconstruction.method: nvdiffrec FlexiCubes geometry + existing nvdiffrast; 64^3 colour grid sampled at dual vertices; degree-2 SH diffuse/specular

setup.cameras: 16 fixed GT cameras, poses and intrinsics never re-estimated
setup.supervision: foreground RGB L1 + symmetric silhouette (w=0.5) + SIFT correspondence (w=0.02) + FlexiCubes L_dev (w=0.1)

correspondence.status: weakly active; Lego texture is sparse

level3_real_reconstruction.sharp_edges: degraded: sharp precision 0.3395 -> 0.1752, burr 0.0162 -> 0.658, sharp accuracy 2.07 -> 4.89 voxel; explicit veto triggered
level3_real_reconstruction.hole_and_thin: holes closed topologically (boundary edges 55397 -> 12, components 3781 -> 5) but thin-structure fidelity lost (accuracy 1.35 -> 3.95 voxel); improvement and degradation conflict

attribution.implementation: dominant: SDF init on a non-watertight VGGT mesh (55397 boundary edges, 3781 components) inflates the extracted surface to 2.0-4.5x area before any supervision; three init routes failed
attribution.method: direction evidence only: optimisation lifts F1 0.4821 -> 0.4915 (+0.0094, 7x noise) but trades precision for recall and inflates area 62.8 -> 90.9; cannot be separated from the init defect
attribution.resource: not binding: grid 256 runs at 13.3 GB torch peak, 387 s, and is worse

tsdf_init_sA: TSDF fusion init, 139.3 m2 vs 30.7 input, heldout silhouette IoU 0.366
depthinit_sA: rendered-depth sign vote, inside_fraction 0.459, IoU 0.425

step_init_2x2.purpose: separate pure 0-step initialisation from 100-step optimisation on a VGGT mesh and a GT-depth proxy mesh; retention relative to each input is the acceptance unit

code_changes.extract_only: --extract-only skips the sdf/weights/deform perturbation, the optimiser and the training loop; summary mode=extract_only, iters=0
code_changes.sign_field: TriangleSDF: exact point-to-nearest-triangle distance over a k=8 centroid shortlist; sign from the closest face normal; closest points on open edges are flagged unreliable; no watertight remeshing
code_changes.visibility: carved / observed / unknown split; background pixels carve, foreground pixels never delete, out-of-frustum voxels keep the surface sign

step_init_2x2.superseded: init_sA (1 Adam step + random perturbation) is no longer a 0-step reference; its numbers stay in #12.8

decision.label: proxy 0-step normal, 100-step degrades -> objective / regularisation / parameterisation

rejected.row1: both 0-step steps keep 96% / 86% of input F1; the common inflation is real but not fatal
rejected.row2: VGGT 0-step retains 96.2% F1 and +59% Chamfer, smaller relative damage than the proxy (+318%)
rejected.row4: proxy degrades 17.5% F1 and halves sharp precision after 100 steps

decision.attribution: initialisation implementation is no longer the dominant cause; 100-step optimisation damages both rows (F1, sharp precision and area all move the wrong way)
decision.next: separate RGB / silhouette / colour-field degrees of freedom (freeze colour, RGB-off, smaller colour grid / no specular) before further sign-field work

invalid_runs: none; smoke_proxy_g64 and smoke_vggt_g64 are grid-64 code-path checks and do not enter the table

acceptance.protocol: phase2_protocol unchanged (same P0 voxel, train-only Sim(3), 50k sampling); historical numbers untouched
acceptance.heldout_render: must not regress (held-out protocol still to be added)
acceptance.resources: <=30 min per arm, nvidia-smi peak delta <=10 GB, run record complete
acceptance.note: 0.75 is above the M2 floor 0.7365; a miss is recorded as a negative result, no post-hoc tuning
